About Prashant Kumar Yadav: Software developer building voice AI and the Go services that keep it on the line.
Prashant is a final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at IIIT Lucknow (2023 to 2027, GPA 8.6).
He has interned at Walmart Global Tech, Nugget by Zomato, Eternal (Zomato), and UBIQCURE, working on voice AI, Go microservices, telephony, data pipelines, AI observability agents, and cloud infrastructure.
He is a regular contributor to stdlib-js, the standard library for JavaScript, with more than 145 merged pull requests.
He likes shipping ambitious systems, instant coffee, and anime.
He is based in Lucknow, India. Website: https://prashantyadav.vercel.app. Resume: /resume.pdf. Email: devprashantkyadav@gmail.com.

Areas of focus: Voice AI pipelines (NLU, TTS, STT, VAD) integrated with Gemini, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, OpenAI, and Groq; High-throughput Go microservices, SIP telephony, and multi-tenant backends; Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps CI/CD with GitHub Actions and ArgoCD on AWS and Azure; Retrieval-augmented generation, LLM agents, and Model Context Protocol tooling; Full-stack web products with React, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

Distributed systems and networking: Raft consensus, Kafka, Microservices, Multi-tenant architecture, SIP telephony, HTTP/3 and QUIC, WebTransport, Nginx, Low-latency C++, Matching engines.

DevOps and cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Kind and k3s, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, GitOps, Jenkins, Trivy, SonarQube, AWS EKS and ECS, Azure, Vercel, Render, Railway, Linux, Infrastructure as Code.

Web3: Move on Aptos, Smart contracts, Thirdweb.

Project: raft-kv. Distributed key-value store built from scratch on Raft: leader election, log replication, and snapshotting over a gRPC transport with durable bbolt storage. Privacy policy of this site: const lastUpdated = "September 2026" export const metadata: Metadata = export default function PrivacyPage() . This is a personal portfolio. It exists to show work and make it easy to get in touch. It does not need much from you, and it does not keep much. What the site collects There are no accounts, no advertising, and no tracking cookies. The hosting platform keeps standard server logs (IP address, browser, page requested) for a short time to keep the site running. Chat messages Dev Senpai answers questions about Prashant using retrieval-augmented generation over the content of this site. Each message you send, along with a few earlier messages from the same conversation, is passed to a third-party language model provider to generate the reply

. Depending on the model you pick, that provider is Groq, Google (Gemini), or OpenAI (ChatGPT), and their own privacy terms apply to that request. Conversations are not stored in a database. First-turn answers may be cached in server memory for up to 12 hours so repeated questions do not use provider quota again. Cached entries contain the question and the answer, nothing that identifies you. Your IP address is used only for rate limiting, and only in server memory. Do not put confidential or sensitive information in the chat. Contact form When you send a message through the contact form, your name, email address, and message are emailed to Prashant through Resend. They are used only to reply to you

. They are used only to reply to you. Sharing Nothing you send is sold, traded, or shared beyond the providers named above, which are needed to deliver the reply or the email. Security Reasonable measures are in place, and everything is served over HTTPS, but no system is perfect. If you shared something by mistake and want it removed from an inbox, send an email and it will be deleted. Changes Any change to this policy is published here with a new date at the top. Questions Email or use the contact form . )
